story.startState: A huge multiplication equation with a plausible wrong answer already dominates frame zero.
story.visibleChange: The answer digit snaps red, separates from the equation and a fracture line splits fluent appearance from correctness.
story.endState: The wrong numeric result is isolated as the visual conflict.

hero.meaning: A fluent-looking answer can still contain a wrong calculation.

recognitionCues.description: red 836 result with unstable final digit

motionPlan.entry: Hero equation is already present at frame zero; no fade from empty.
motionPlan.development: Wrong digit snaps, shifts and fractures the equation in short weighted moves.
motionPlan.payoff: Wrong result remains isolated while the rest of the equation recedes.

story.startState: The equation persists as the shared object entering the mechanism explanation.
story.visibleChange: Characters break into staggered tokens, travel along a path and feed a shared candidate axis.
story.endState: A token winner exits the candidate distribution and rejoins the stream.

hero.meaning: The language model advances through likely next-token choices.

recognitionCues.description: separate text and number token blocks
shared candidate bars with one winner

motionPlan.entry: Shared equation compresses into the token rail without a decorative transition.
motionPlan.development: Tokens stagger left-to-right while candidate bars grow in a short wave.
motionPlan.payoff: Winning token locks into the outgoing stream and the camera follows it forward.

story.startState: A green multi-step arithmetic dependency path is intact and readable.
story.visibleChange: One intermediate result flips red and a red error pulse travels through every dependent step.
story.endState: The complete downstream branch and final result are visibly contaminated by that one error.

hero.meaning: One wrong intermediate calculation can propagate to dependent steps.

recognitionCues.description: red pulse moving along dependency path
final answer changes after the cascade

motionPlan.entry: All steps are visible and initially green so the later failure has a baseline.
motionPlan.development: A single node flips, then short staggered path segments carry the error cause-to-effect.
motionPlan.payoff: Final answer turns red only after the visible causal chain reaches it.

story.startState: The arithmetic input waits before a split route: language path or tool path.
story.visibleChange: The active route bends into a calculator terminal, executes the multiplication and sends the result back.
story.endState: The green tool result returns as a separate verified calculation output.

hero.meaning: A tool can perform the calculation while the language model handles explanation and routing.

recognitionCues.description: visible arrow route into and out of the tool
green 846 result returning to the model

motionPlan.entry: Input object holds while the route bifurcates toward the tool.
motionPlan.development: Path draws into terminal, expression types, result snaps in, then return path activates.
motionPlan.payoff: 846 exits terminal as a distinct green object and reconnects to the equation.

story.startState: Wrong 836 and tool-verified 846 briefly occupy the same comparison space.
story.visibleChange: 836 is crossed out, 846 snaps into the original equation and the final rule assembles word by word.
story.endState: The verified equation and RECHNUNG PRÜFEN rule remain as the final verdict.

hero.meaning: Important numbers should be checked by calculation, not trusted because prose sounds fluent.

motionPlan.entry: Both competing results enter already readable for an immediate comparison.
motionPlan.development: Wrong value exits, correct value locks in and verdict words stagger with controlled emphasis.
motionPlan.payoff: Check mark lands after the rule so the reel ends on a concrete action.
